horizon_anchor: Each horizon compares its expected direction with outcome.direction_<horizon>m, which is derived from the same pre-release anchor in the frozen Outcome record.
path_score: mean(direction_5m_ok, direction_15m_ok, direction_30m_ok, direction_60m_ok) for non-NO_SIGNAL predictions; null for valid NO_SIGNAL predictions.
proposal_evaluator_mismatch: The executor counted accepted forecast arms as lifecycle-complete before requiring the primary directional endpoint; the evaluator itself correctly treats NO_SIGNAL as non-directional.
valid_no_signal: status VALID with direction fields and path score null; no_signal_ok records quiet-outcome agreement.
